old: Teamwork Commerce combines iOS-native architecture, a proprietary AI agent, an industry-leading native end-to-end RFID stack, and 30+ years of retail DNA, in one system with 99.99% uptime across 40+ countries. Most platforms in this category reach RFID through a third-party integration layer; ours is native to the POS.
new: The practical difference is where RFID lives. Most platforms in this category reach it through a third-party integration layer, so tag reads arrive as an import after the fact. Ours runs inside the POS, which is why receiving, counting, transferring and selling all operate by individual EPC. The iOS-native architecture, the AI agent and the 30+ years behind the product matter too, but RFID is the one that changes how a store actually works. Uptime is 99.99% in 40+ countries.

old: Teamwork Commerce combines the polished iOS interface, native RFID precision, AI clienteling, consignment/deposit management, and global compliance across 40+ countries, in one platform
new: Luxury puts weight on two things most platforms treat as secondary: knowing exactly what exists when a run is small, and knowing the client well enough to call them about it. RFID precision covers the first; clienteling, consignment and deposit handling cover the second. The iOS interface and compliance in 40+ countries are table stakes at this level
